mapper.select: select sole_id as soleId, sole_name as soleName, sole_fields as soleFields, sole_cycle_times soleCycleTimes, customer_info as customerInfo, `status` as status, DATE_FORMAT(update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime, opt_user_id as optUserId, opt_user_name as optUserName from b_sole_opt_log where is_del=1 and sole_id= #{id} order by update_time desc,id desc
